description: This PHP file defines a class 'Country' within the Opencart admin controller namespace. The class provides methods to generate, list, retrieve info, and clear country-related data, including generating JSON files with country details. It interacts with models for tasks, localisation data, zones, and handles file operations for JSON data storage.

classes.name: Country
classes.description: A controller class managing country-related administrative tasks such as listing countries, generating country info files, and cleanup of related JSON files.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Initializes country tasks by clearing old data and creating new task entries.

methods.name: list
methods.description: Generates a list of countries, creates a JSON file with country data, and queues tasks per country.

methods.name: info
methods.description: Generates a detailed JSON file for a specific country, including zones and descriptions.

methods.name: clear
methods.description: Removes generated JSON files related to countries.
